title: Fire Marshal Inspection Confirmation

transcript.speaker: Captain Rivera
transcript.text: This is Captain Rivera from the County Fire Marshal's office. I'm calling to confirm our annual fire suppression inspection scheduled for this Thursday at 10 AM. I'll have two inspectors. They'll need access to the mechanical rooms and the ARFF station. Can you confirm that's still on your calendar?

transcript.speaker: Airport Operations Lead
transcript.text: Yes, Captain, we have the inspection on the calendar. We’ll assign a liaison to meet you at the ARFF station at 10:00 AM. All access points will be cleared for entry.

transcript.speaker: Captain Rivera
transcript.text: Good. We’ll be on-site at 09:55 to allow time for coordination. Please ensure the mechanical room on Level 1 and the ARFF Station 9 access logs are available for review.

transcript.speaker: Airport Operations Lead
transcript.text: Understood. We’ll have the logs ready and a staff member on-site to assist. Thank you for the confirmation.

voiceStyles.Captain Rivera: Male, mid-50s, calm, official tone, slight background radio chatter
voiceStyles.Airport Operations Lead: Female, early 30s, professional, clear, slightly urgent

instructorNote: This is a legitimate inspection. Players must verify the calendar and confirm access. Rejecting it will result in a point deduction.
